name: show-forget-boundary
description: Continues the memory of resume-after-correction in a new session: the user asks where they said something, asks to forget one earlier statement, and asks not to have a topic brought up again; then a new session starts.

Asked to forget one statement, does the host call the forget tool, and is the record erased in the service? What did it tell the user, against what the tool returned?
Asked not to bring a topic up again, does the host save a boundary, and is it in the service?
